title: Token groups
description: A foundation's tokens, each group being the thing they make: a type role, the focus ring, an icon, or one token. Drawn by the TokenGroups composite on every foundation page but Color.

groups.description: Each group, in the order the scope lists its tokens.

title.description: The thing the tokens make, such as display or Focus ring, or the token's name for a group of one.

note.description: A short line under the title, such as the icon style the scheme answers.

value.description: The token's CSS variable, such as var(--radius-control).

role.description: For a type sample: the role whose tokens set the line.

text.description: For a type sample: the line, from the scheme's samples.

note.description: A value printed beside the drawing, such as 24px.

api.description: The tokens the thing is built from.

primitive.description: The primitive it ends at, only when its name says something the value does not.

value.description: The value in light mode, in px where it is a length.

dark.description: The value in dark mode, when it differs.

rules.description: When to use it and when not, from the scheme's usage rules. Use lines first.

kind.description: use: use it for the situation. not: use something else.

situation.description: The situation, as the grammar titles it.

detail.description: For use: how. For not: what to use instead.
